msg: There are four rounds, each signified by the basket background. The rules for highest points seem to vary between rounds, but the gnomes with the highest values seem to stay the same in each round. It's better to guess when its a 1x round so you can get higher points on the 5x rounds. In the first two rounds the green and purple gnomes seem to be the highest points. The shorter rounded gnomes also seem to be better.In the 3rd and 4th rounds the pointed hat gnomes seem to have the greater points. Remember to test your guesses on the 1x rounds!
